status: 설계 사양. 새 구현·GPU 실행·원격 지시 전달 결과가 아니다.

method_inputs.history: 자기 branch의 native state; inner 고정, B1은 W0 규약
method_inputs.generic_reference: 고정 C4 S64 inputs와 full-vocabulary W0 log probabilities

proposal.raw_endpoint: actual stored FP32 native provisional endpoint Vp on own current branch
proposal.writer: S_t(R)=R A_t; actual source solve/transpose/context-repeat semantics

current_quality.loss: canonical desired teacher-forced NLL; token mean per request then mean over all100 requests
current_quality.success_anchor: Ap=IDs whose entire canonical desired answer passes pinned native TF-strict evaluator at Vp
constraints: Ap is a subset of candidate TF-strict success IDs
current_quality.ambiguous_numeric_comparison: 동일 kernel/reduction 재검사 또는 RAW 우선; 양의 품질 악화 tolerance를 tuning하지 않음

direction.coordinates: V(C)=Vp+C A_t; C=0 directly restores native bytes
direction.zero_gE: d=-gD; finite current-quality screen still required
direction.metric: Euclidean residual coordinates; not native-metric or weight-space projection
direction.zeta_role: executable correction trust; not a KL damage allowance
direction.numeric_constants_status: 실제 모델 기술 검사에서 고정; 아직 미측정
direction.target_projection: Zp+alpha*d onto same native per-request anchor/radius balls
direction.correction: C=projected_target-Zp; retract C if needed to ||C A_t||<=zeta||Vp-Wentry||

selection.objective: minimum actual D64 among finite candidates satisfying current_quality
selection.D64: fixed W0 KL(p0||pV), vocab sum ->128 scored positions mean ->64 documents mean
selection.backtrack_scales: correction only; never the entire native write
selection.numeric_uncertainty: RAW 우선; nonfinite candidate 제외 및 사유 기록
selection.native_nonfinite_or_execution_failure: technical failure; not successful policy fallback
selection.local_statement: exact finite screen gives D(selected)<=D(own raw) and declared current constraints

transaction.accepted_label_ledger: final-model canonical strict success only; desired label and acceptance loss recorded
transaction.active_superseded: 고정 task의 exact subject/relation 규칙; accepted 요청에 의한 갱신만 허용; semantic conflict 전체 해결 보증이 아님

pipeline.Dev128_required_for: W5/W10 development report, not the online gradient

first_experiment.baseline_reuse_condition: matching W0/order/source/checkpoint identity; missing C4 endpoint metrics remain unmeasured

later_modules_in_order_of_need: unprojected -gD with identical finite quality screen
bounded quality restoration if finite curvature rejection observed
explicit old-retention feasibility and conflict policy
target refresh/two committed stages with strong one-shot and cost comparators

final_claim_plan.policies: locked selected method plus five user-named baselines

later_quality_restoration_proposal.trigger_candidate: finite/trust/Ap 및 D(raw) 개선을 만족하고 평균 E만 실패한 후보 중 E-Ep가 가장 작은 후보
later_quality_restoration_proposal.guards: native target ball과 전체 correction trust 재적용; actual E/Ap/D screen; zero/nonfinite gradient면 생략
later_quality_restoration_proposal.failure: RAW 포함 기존 quality-feasible 후보 중 min D
later_quality_restoration_proposal.guarantee: 선형화된 위반 복원 제안; nonlinear feasibility 또는 수렴 보증 없음

later_continuous_interpretation.role: quality-feasible projected gradient dynamics; 후속 해석이며 첫 controller의 보증 아님
